caveats: 8 days of data, one market regime
points were set after seeing the data: the halves show stability, not an independent test
survivorship: coins that rugged before minute 5 or never left the curve are not in the data
a RugCheck report without warnings on a coin minutes old proves little
the radar's own records are the first forward test
